cohort: 150 parturients with category II cardiotocography (CTG) abnormalities were studied.
finding: Minimal beat-to-beat variability, tachycardia, and variable decelerations showed a higher correlation with adverse neonatal outcomes.
mod_finding: The mode of delivery differed significantly between various CTG abnormalities.
gest_age: most patients were in the early term (37w-38w 6d)
